issue: Expulsion of a foreign worker convicted of unlawful residence after his sponsor ended his employment
holding_from_official_principles: Conviction for unlawful residence (charge amended from working for a non-sponsor) and expulsion order under art. 19 of Law 3/1963 upheld; appeal rejected

issue: Elements of the offence of a foreigner working for someone other than the sponsor (art. 19(1) Law 3/1963)
holding_from_official_principles: Conviction quashed for insufficient reasoning: the offence requires a work licence tied to a named sponsor, sponsorship by that person, and that the worker is not in an exempt category; the judgment did not identify the sponsor or the actual employer

issue: Long-serving worker's claim for end-of-service dues, transfer of sponsorship and housing allowance
holding_from_official_principles: Employer bound by contract to provide housing is released only by providing it; the lower court erred in denying the housing allowance because the worker had not claimed it for 18 years (partly quashed)

issue: Female worker's claim for unpaid wages, remaining contract salary, compensation and return ticket
holding_from_official_principles: Nursing without the licence required by Law 8/1991 makes the employment contract absolutely void (public order), so no contractual claims can be based on it; lower judgment enforcing the contract quashed

issue: Worker's claim including return ticket; scope of the court-fee exemption for labour claims
holding_from_official_principles: Fee exemption for labour claims (Labour Law art. 10) covers only claims arising from the Labour Law or the employment contract; this claim did not, so the appeal deposit was due and the appeal was inadmissible

issue: Worker's claim for notice pay, end-of-service gratuity, leave pay and return ticket
